MowPattern.description:
The pattern settings of a native start (``StartMow.pattern``) that every client offers:
the pattern, its base angle, the border laps and the path spacing, plus the job options a
mower may declare in ``MowerCapabilities.start_options`` (obstacle detection, laps around
no-go zones, path order, start progress; ADR 0030 amendment of 2026-10-24). An option left
None is not sent, so the mower keeps its own default.

Adapters may accept further keys in ``StartMow.pattern``; this is the common, validated
part, also kept per mower as the mowing defaults in Fleet (``MowerOut.mow_defaults``).
Whether the mower runs the pattern is decided with ``MowerCapabilities.native_patterns``.

angle_deg.description: Base angle of the stripes in degrees (diagonal adds 45, checkerboard crosses at 90; ignored for `edge_only` and `random_angle`).
angle_deg.title: Angle Deg

border_laps.description: Laps along the area edge before the fill (`edge_only`: at least one).
border_laps.title: Border Laps

obstacle_detection.description: Obstacle detection mode of the job; None keeps the mower's default. Offered modes: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection`.

obstacle_laps.description: Laps around each no-go zone; None keeps the mower's default. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_laps_range`.
obstacle_laps.title: Obstacle Laps

order.description: Border laps before or after the fill; None keeps the mower's default. Offered orders: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.orders`.

spacing_m.description: Distance between neighbouring paths in metres; None for the mower's own default. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.path_spacing_range_mm`.
spacing_m.title: Spacing M

start_progress_pct.description: Start the job at this progress in percent, skipping the first part of the route; None (or 0) starts at the beginning. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.start_progress_range_pct`.
start_progress_pct.title: Start Progress Pct

MowPattern.title: MowPattern

ObstacleDetection.description:
How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (``MowPattern``).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware
(``MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection``). The names follow the vendor apps:
``off`` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, ``standard`` avoids obstacles it sees ahead,
``sensitive`` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; ``slow_touch`` and
``less_touch`` exist only on older firmware.
ObstacleDetection.title: ObstacleDetection

PathOrder.description: Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.
PathOrder.title: PathOrder

TargetMower.description: One mower of a resolved target with the place of its site.

mow_pattern.description: The mower's saved mowing defaults (`MowerOut.mow_defaults.pattern`); None when none are saved. A scheduled start begins with them and lays the keys the schedule sets (`SchedulePattern`) over them.

description:
Reply to :class:`ResolveTargetRequest`.

``found`` is False when the target does not exist in the account. ``timezone`` is the
target's own time zone: the mower's site, the group's site, or for a cross-site group the
account's default site.
